# sentinelBurnR

An R package for ecological monitoring using Sentinel-2 imagery.

## Installation

```r
remotes::install_github("julianflowers/sentinelBurnR")
```

## Example

```r
library(sentinelBurnR)

aoi <- read_aoi(
    system.file(
        "extdata",
        "sizewell_aoi.gpkg",
        package = "sentinelBurnR"
    )
)
```
